prompt: A box of 50 coffee pods costs $30, but the pods expire in 6 weeks. You use 5 pods a week, so some pods will expire unused. What is the effective cost per pod that you actually use?
explanation: Pods you actually use before the expiry date: 5 per week x 6 weeks = 30 pods. Effective cost per used pod: $30 / 30 = $1.00. The $0.60 option divides by all 50 pods in the box ($30 / 50) and ignores the 20 pods that expire unused.
